title: ADR Provenance
description: Machine-readable freshness stamps for docs/adr/*.md's concrete repo-path citations, keyed by 4-digit ADR number. One aggregate file, not a per-ADR sidecar (docs/reference/provenance.schema.json's per-page granularity tracks named sections/symbols; an ADR's file citations have no equivalent section structure). Generated by bin/gen-adr-provenance.mjs; verified by bin/check-adr-provenance.mjs (advisory — a drift finding means 're-read this ADR', never 'this ADR is wrong').

sourceFiles.description: Every repo-relative path this ADR cites in backticks that resolved to a real file on disk, sorted by path.

path.description: File path relative to the repo root.

blob.description: Git blob SHA (git hash-object <file>) of this source file's content when last verified. Content-addressed, so a rebase that leaves the file byte-identical never marks it stale.

verifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) bumped only when this ADR's source list or any blob actually changed — a bare re-run of gen:adr-provenance never advances it.
